newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT offers German global express service.
newsitem.headline: TNT offers German global express service.

text.p: TNT Express Gmbh, the German domestic express service, said it has introduced a global express service for documents and parcels.

The new Express Pak service operated in co-operation with its sister company GD Express Worldwide, offers customers both domestic and international services from a single supplier, a TNT statement said.
Parcels and goods up to a weight limit of 30kg could be flown to destinations in one of five price zones.
TNT Express sales and marketing manager for Germany, Raimund Stuer, said: "With this service we are meeting the wish of our clients to offer worldwide deliveries out of one hand."

TNT said it offers guaranteed delivery times door-to-door for express documents, tracking and tracing of the goods and delivery notes on request. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
